slipwaddle: A small navy penguin lying flat on its tummy with its head up, an orange beak and flipper, a clear white oval belly on its side, and two small cyan puffs of snow behind it.
sledwaddle: A bigger flat penguin with an orange curl on its head, an orange flipper, a white oval belly on its side and the small cyan snow puffs behind it.
blizzwaddle: The biggest flat penguin: orange curl on its head, orange fins along its back, a ring of cyan puffs at its front, a white oval belly on its side and small cyan puffs behind it.
oinkle: A small pink piglet with a long low body and a round head set forward, a flat round snout disc, two triangle ears, dark eyes and a short stub of tail on its rump.
snortle: A bigger pink pig: the head sticks out in front of the long body, with a snout disc, triangle ears, a tuft of pink bubbles on top and the stub tail. No flank oval.
tuskoink: The biggest pig: head forward of the long body, a snout disc with a small white tusk angled up beside it, a tuft of pink bubbles on top, triangle ears, pink spikes along its back and the stub tail.
cubbun: A small tan bear sitting up and holding a big red heart (two round lobes with a point below) against its chest, with tan arms and small paw pads at the heart's lower front. The paws sit close together at the bottom; they do not clearly meet at the front centre.
brambun: A bigger bear with a green leaf sprout on its head and the same big red heart held to its chest, tan arms and small paw pads at the bottom front.
grizzbun: The biggest bear: a flat russet leaf crown on top of its head, and the same big red heart held to its chest with tan arms and small paw pads at the bottom front.
spudsy: A small round tan potato with one tiny green sprout on top, brown bumps, two stubby arms and four stubby feet.
tatertot: A bigger potato with a taller green leaf sprout, brown bumps, stubby arms and feet.
hashbrawn: The biggest potato: a tuft of green leaves on top, brown bumps, long arms and four feet.
cloudlamb: A pale blue-white cloud-shaped sheep floating just above the ground, with puffs of cloud on its top, small pale ears and a ring of puffs underneath, eyes closed.
cumulamb: A bigger floating cloud sheep with more puffs on top and underneath, and two golden crescent horns on the sides of its head.
fluffasus: The biggest cloud sheep: a pale blue-lilac cloud body with closed eyes, puffs along its top, a ring of white puffs underneath, a small blue ear, and a fan of peach feather-lobe wings swept back off its rump. It floats a little over its shadow. No horns are visible.
glimbug: A dark purple bug of a small head ball over a big round belly, standing on the floor with its shadow under it, with two pale yellow antennae, a wide yellow wing out to the side, a small smile and a big glowing pale-yellow lobe behind it. No crown yet.
glimmerbug: A bigger dark bug, on the floor, with a crown of pale yellow spikes added over its antennae, the yellow wing and the glowing lobe.
beaconfly: The biggest dark bug, on the floor: much wider pale-yellow wings than Glimmerbug's, cream round hands held out in front, the spike crown and the tall glowing lobe behind. The wide wings are the outline step up.
lampfin: A round dark-blue fish sitting just over its shadow on the floor, with a short beaded cream stalk to a round cream lure, cream fins, yellow eyes and a small smile. No teeth.
lanternfin: A bigger blue fish on the floor with a larger cream lure on its stalk, cream fins on its back and tail, yellow eyes and a small smile.
nightfin: The biggest blue fish: a huge cream lure, cream back fins, two small blue spikes on top of its head clear of the fins, and yellow eyes. Epic sparkle tier: small white flecks across its body.
dragofruit: A small round pink dragonfruit sitting on its shadow, with green spikes over its back and top, a spiky green tail, closed happy eyes, a smile and clear pink blush.
drakeberry: A bigger pink dragonfruit sitting on its shadow, with taller green spikes on its back, pink nubs for wings, closed happy eyes and a clear blush on its cheek.
dragonbloom: The biggest dragonfruit, sitting on its shadow: a large pale green wing swept up behind it, green spikes on its back, closed happy eyes, a smile and a clear blush.
quackle: A small yellow rubber duck shaped like a low flat boat, with a wide flat orange bill, closed happy eyes, the back of the hull swept up into a single point, and a short curl of small bubbles above its head.
bubbleduck: A bigger yellow duck: a longer, denser curl of bubbles above its head, the swept-up tail point, with a small bubble shadow trailing beside the hull shadow.
soapduke: The biggest duck: a white ruff of round suds spheres in an arc under its bill, sticking out past the front of the hull, with the tallest curl of bubbles arcing back over its hull and the swept-up tail point. The bill is clear. The ruff is a front arc, not a full ring.
